# Appdoers Limited

> New Zealand website design, development, hosting, and support for businesses, churches, and organisations.

Appdoers Limited (NZBN 9429052210952) builds fast, professional websites with clear monthly pricing. Teams in Ashburton (Canterbury) and New Plymouth (Taranaki) serve clients across Aotearoa.

## Services

- Basic Website: public sites for trades, cafés, churches, and small organisations
- Full Website: member areas, events, rosters, and admin tools for active churches and businesses
- Hosting, security, and ongoing support included in plans
